title: ApplicationReview
description: Detailed analytical review for a posting under postings/{slug}/. Written by /review-application; consumed by /build-cv and on-demand reading. The workflow-spine fields (status, status_changed_at, cv_built_at) live in the root-level applications.yaml, not here.

posting_slug.description: Directory name under postings/. Format: YYYY-MM-DD_{company}_{title_kebab}. Date prefix is the discovery date (ASC-sortable).

summary.description: Plain-language brief on whether this posting suits the candidate. Written by /scan-indeed, /scan-companies, and /review-application. Each field is a short paragraph (2-5 sentences); skip a field only if the posting genuinely says nothing about it.

office_and_location.description: Where the role is based, remote/hybrid/onsite expectations, commute reality from the primary location (location.primary). Call out anything notable: relocation requirements, specific office days, multi-site travel.

compensation.description: Stated salary vs the candidate's bands in config/job_seeker.yaml (compensation floor / target / stretch, sector-adjusted). Comment on bonus, equity, benefits if mentioned. If salary is absent, say so and infer from seniority where possible.

mission_and_culture.description: What the company actually builds, mission statement, and how it maps to the candidate's strong preferences in config/job_seeker.yaml. Note any culture signals from the posting (engineering culture, autonomy, on-call expectations, learning budget).

technical_fit.description: Tech stack alignment with the candidate's must-haves and strong preferences in config/job_seeker.yaml. Where the role plays to their strengths and where it stretches them. Be concrete about the named tools.

overall.description: One-paragraph synthesis: is this appropriate to apply to? What should the candidate pay attention to in the JD or at interview? Honest verdict; do not boost a weak match.
